newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thailand okays rice-for-plane deal with Indonesia.
newsitem.headline: Thailand okays rice-for-plane deal with Indonesia.

text.p: The cabinet on Tuesday approved a counter trade deal whereby Thailand will sell 110,000 tonnes of rice to Indonesia and buy two Indonesian-made aircraft in return, a government official said.
The official told Reuters that Thailand would buy two CASA CN-235 aircraft made by Indonesia's state-owned Industri Pesawat Terbang Nusantara (IPTN) for 831.59 million baht (US$33.27 million).
